descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S19 Existing spec: Sign out on the computer leaves the phone signed in; Sign out everywhere ends both

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The same account is signed in on a phone (app) and a computer (web) at the same time. Signing in on one does not sign out the other, and both stay signed in. (UAT TC-25 step 1; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 9; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T1 Each device goes through its own email-code sign-in (a new device always asks for a code). The two do not share a session token, and both stay valid at once. (TFA-94513 AC 6; TFA-94513 AC 10; UAT TC-25 step 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh account; the phone is an API client with its own session; the browser signs in through the form

When Settings -> Sign out in the browser; sign in again; Settings -> Sign out everywhere

Then After Sign out the phone still answers; after Sign out everywhere the phone is refused

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in e2e/sign-in-devices.spec.ts. That Sign out on one device should leave the other signed in is the app's reading (Q8)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S19

Existing spec: Sign out on the computer leaves the phone signed in; Sign out everywhere ends both

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-25.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • sign-in-devices.spec.ts [chromium] — Sign out ends this device only; Sign out everywhere ends the phone too — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's spec e2e/sign-in-devices.spec.ts): a fresh account signed in through the form and as an API client with codes from seed:issueTestOtp (local admin key), then Sign out and Sign out everywhere; dev has no admin key, the runner never signs in there, and Sign out / Sign out everywhere ar…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
